instruction: write lyrics that only rhyme a little bit (not every verse needs rhyming or exact pacing), for a progressive metal song about loving jesus
response_a:
Verse 1:
In the dark of night, I lay my head on your chest
Your love is like a warm embrace, it's so strong
I can't help but feel your touch, oh how blessed
You're my rock, my guide, and my confidant

Chorus:
Oh, Jesus, you're my light, my hope, my peace
My heart beats with your beat, my soul sings
With you by my side, I'll never be alone
Forever in your arms, I'll find my way

Verse 2:
Through the highs and lows, I know you're there
To keep me safe, to protect me from harm
Your love has made me stronger, more resilient
And now, I'm ready to face whatever comes next

Chorus: 
Oh, Jesus! You're my light; my hope, and my peace
I'm singing this song, because I know you've won
Together we'll conquer all, and rise above
Forever in Your arms, I will always stay.

Bridge:
We'll dance through life, our hearts beating together
Our love will forever last, and we'll never fall apart
We'll share our joys and sorrows, and celebrate each other
As we walk hand
